about: HeartGold/SoulSilver story steps for the guide panel's NEXT section, written by hand for this site. done/todo conditions are read from the save data in DS RAM: f:N event flag, t:N trainer beaten, b:N Johto badge bit, k:N Kanto badge bit, v:VAR>=N story variable (hex id); | is any, & is all (binds tighter). An empty condition is never checked off. A step also counts as done once any later step is done, unless it is free (Kanto gyms: any order). Text in {HeartGold|SoulSilver} picks the version. Boss teams come from bosses.json (tools/story_data.py); a Rival with t: [a, b, c] is picked by the player's starter (Chikorita, Cyndaquil, Totodile). maps lists where the 'trainers on the way' come from (name or name/place in hgss.json).

steps.title: Get your first Pokémon
steps.text: Head next door to Prof. Elm's Lab and pick your partner. Cyndaquil (Fire) has the easiest start: it handles Bugsy, Jasmine and Pryce well. Totodile (Water) is solid all game. Chikorita (Grass) is the hard mode for the first gyms.
todo: Talk to Prof. Elm and choose a starter
steps.watch: Before you leave, Mom sets up your Pokégear. The phone matters: Elm will call you when the story moves on.

steps.title: Run Elm's errand to Mr. Pokémon
steps.text: Elm wants you to visit Mr. Pokémon, who lives at the far north end of Route 30. Walk west on Route 29 to Cherrygrove City, then north up Route 30 to the house past the berry trees.
todo: Let the old man in Cherrygrove show you around (free Map card)
Reach Mr. Pokémon's house on Route 30: you get the Mystery Egg and Prof. Oak gives you the Pokédex
catch: Flying types you'll want against Bugsy's bugs and Chuck's fighters
fast early hitters; Rattata learns Bite early, handy for Morty later
steps.watch: You can't catch yet (no Poké Balls until you get back to Elm). Heal at the Cherrygrove Pokémon Center on the way.

steps.title: Beat your rival in Cherrygrove
steps.text: On your way back, Elm calls in a panic: something was stolen from his lab. When you walk back into Cherrygrove, the red-haired boy who was lurking outside the lab stops you and battles. He has the starter that is strong against yours.

boss.name: Rival
boss.type: One Pokémon, the starter with the type advantage over yours
boss.tip: Only one Pokémon at level 5. Get your starter to level 7-8 on Route 29-30 first and spam its damaging move; heal with your Potion when you drop under half.

steps.title: Report back to Prof. Elm
steps.text: Go back east on Route 29 to Elm's Lab. A police officer asks about the thief: this is where you name your rival. Elm takes the Mystery Egg to study it and sends you on your way to Violet City.
todo: Give the rival's name to the officer
Talk to Elm about the Egg

steps.title: Head to Violet City and climb Sprout Tower
steps.text: On Route 29 your friend shows you how to catch Pokémon and hands you 5 Poké Balls. Then go back through Cherrygrove and up Routes 30 and 31 to Violet City. The Gym won't open until you prove yourself in Sprout Tower, the swaying wooden tower in the north of town.
todo: Watch the catching lesson on Route 29 (5 Poké Balls)
Climb Sprout Tower and beat Elder Li at the top (TM70 Flash)
catch: Rock/Ground, walls Falkner's birds and learns Rock Throw; good vs Whitney too
Electric: great vs Falkner, later vs Chuck's Poliwrath and Clair's Gyarados
trade it to the kid in the Violet house for an Onix (Rock)
a Bug-type option if you want variety

boss.name: Elder Li
boss.tip: Two Bellsprout and a level 10 Hoothoot. Fire or Flying moves clear it fast; Geodude walls the Hoothoot.

steps.watch: The sages in Sprout Tower all use Bellsprout plus Hoothoot or Rattata. Kill some time leveling here: aim for level 12-14 before Falkner.

steps.title: Gym 1: Falkner
steps.text: Falkner's Pidgeotto is the real fight: it hits with Gust and heals with Roost. His Pidgey uses Sand-Attack to lower your accuracy.
todo: Beat Falkner for the Zephyr Badge (and TM51 Roost)

boss.name: Gym Leader Falkner
boss.tip: Geodude, Onix or Mareep make this easy. Chikorita users: catch one of those first.

steps.title: Collect the Egg from Elm's aide
steps.text: Elm calls after your first badge: his assistant is waiting for you at the Violet City Poké Mart with the Egg. Walk around with it in your party and it hatches into Togepi.
todo: Talk to Elm's aide in the Violet Poké Mart

steps.title: Go south to Azalea Town
steps.where: Route 32 → Union Cave → Route 33 → Azalea Town
steps.text: Take Route 32 south from Violet (the Ruins of Alph to the west are optional). Go through Union Cave to Route 33 and Azalea Town. Team Rocket is cutting the tails off the Slowpoke in Slowpoke Well. Follow Kurt into the well and drive them out.
todo: Get the Old Rod from the fisher in the Route 32 Pokémon Center
Clear Team Rocket out of Slowpoke Well and beat Proton
catch: Rock: strong defence vs Bugsy and Whitney
Water/Ground, only weak to Grass. Great all-rounder
evolves into Crobat, one of the best Johto Flying types
Grass/Flying: resists Fighting, so it's handy against Chuck later

boss.name: Executive Proton
boss.tip: Zubat and Koffing. Geodude/Onix shrug off their attacks; watch out for poison and pack Antidotes.

steps.watch: Route 32 has the most trainers so far. Bring Antidotes for Union Cave and the well.

steps.title: Gym 2: Bugsy
steps.text: Ride the Spinarak carts across the gym. Bugsy's level 17 Scyther is the danger: it boosts with Focus Energy, hits first with Quick Attack and uses U-turn. Kakuna and Metapod are easy.
todo: Beat Bugsy for the Hive Badge (and TM89 U-turn)

boss.name: Gym Leader Bugsy
boss.tip: Level 17-18 recommended. Onix, Geodude, Pidgeotto or Cyndaquil all do well. Take Scyther down quickly before Focus Energy pays off.

steps.title: Rival battle at the Azalea exit
steps.text: Walk west toward Ilex Forest and your rival jumps you again, now with three Pokémon.

boss.name: Rival
boss.weak: Gastly: Psychic, Ghost, Dark. Zubat: Electric, Rock, Psychic, Ice
boss.tip: Normal and Fighting moves can't touch Gastly. Bite or a Psychic move handles it; save your best counter for his starter.

steps.title: Ilex Forest: herd the Farfetch'd, get Cut
steps.text: The charcoal maker's Farfetch'd ran off into the forest. Find it and walk up behind it so it runs back toward the entrance (twice). His father then gives you HM01 Cut, which you need for the tree blocking the forest's exit.
todo: Find both of the charcoal maker's Farfetch'd
Get HM01 Cut from the charcoal man
catch: Grass/Poison: good against Chuck's Poliwrath and the many Water types later
learns Spore later: sleep is great for catching

steps.title: Gym 3: Whitney
steps.text: North of the forest, Route 34 leads to Goldenrod City, the big city. Grab the free Bicycle at the Bike Shop, the Radio Card from the Radio Tower quiz and an Eevee from Bill at his house. Then take on Whitney, whose Miltank is famous for wiping teams.
todo: Get the Radio Card (answer the quiz on Radio Tower 1F)
Get Eevee from Bill at his Goldenrod house
Trade a Drowzee (Route 34) for Machop on Department Store 5F (optional but strongly recommended)
Beat Whitney. If she cries after the battle, talk to her again for the Plain Badge
catch: trade it for Machop: Fighting is the answer to Miltank
teleports away; put it to sleep or catch it on the first ball. Kadabra is a top Psychic attacker

boss.name: Gym Leader Whitney
boss.tip: Miltank uses Rollout (gets stronger every turn), Milk Drink and Stomp, plus Attract on male Pokémon. Use female or Rock/Steel Pokémon to take Rollout, and hit it with Fighting moves. Geodude/Onix resist Rollout. Level 20+ helps.

steps.title: Water the odd tree on Route 36
steps.text: A strange tree blocks Route 36. With the Plain Badge, the Goldenrod Flower Shop gives you the SquirtBottle. Go north on Route 35, then east past the National Park to the tree and water it. It's a Sudowoodo (Rock, level 20). Afterwards a man nearby gives you HM06 Rock Smash.
todo: Get the SquirtBottle from the Goldenrod Flower Shop
Water the odd tree: Sudowoodo battle (catch it if you like)
catch: Rock: good defender; Water/Grass/Fighting beat it
Fire: needed vs Jasmine and Pryce if you didn't pick Cyndaquil
steps.watch: The National Park Bug-Catching Contest runs Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday: a good way to catch Scyther or Pinsir.

steps.title: Ecruteak: the Burned Tower
steps.text: Route 37 leads north to Ecruteak City. Morty isn't in his Gym: the man inside says he went to the Burned Tower. Inside, your rival battles you, then you fall to the basement and wake the three legendary beasts (Raikou, Entei and Suicune), who run off. Morty and Eusine are there too.
todo: Beat the rival in the Burned Tower
Go down to the basement and see the legendary beasts
catch: Ghost: evolves into Haunter, good vs Morty's team
Poison; learns Sludge and SmokeScreen, a sturdy pick for the Rocket fights later

boss.name: Rival
boss.weak: Gastly/Zubat: Psychic, Electric; Magnemite: Fire, Ground, Fighting
boss.tip: Four Pokémon around level 20-22. Bring Potions and a counter for his starter.

steps.title: Gym 4: Morty
steps.text: The gym is pitch black: only the hidden path across the floor is safe. Fall off and you start again. Normal and Fighting moves can't hit his Ghosts. Gengar and Haunter use Hypnosis (Haunter follows up with Dream Eater), and Mean Look plus Curse traps and drains you.
todo: Beat Morty for the Fog Badge (and TM30 Shadow Ball)

boss.name: Gym Leader Morty
boss.tip: Normal and Fighting moves don't hit at all. Kadabra (Psychic), Haunter (Ghost), Raticate with Bite, or Geodude/Graveler with Magnitude all work. Bring Awakenings for Hypnosis. Aim for level 25+.

steps.title: Win Surf at the Dance Theater
steps.text: A Team Rocket grunt is pestering one of the Kimono Girls on the Dance Theater stage. Beat him and the gentleman watching from the audience gives you HM03 Surf, which you can use outside battle now that you have the Fog Badge.
todo: Chase off the Rocket grunt in the Dance Theater and get HM03 Surf
steps.watch: Teach Surf to a Water type (Totodile line, Wooper, Poliwag). It opens up most of the rest of Johto.

steps.title: Olivine City, then surf to Cianwood
steps.where: Route 38 → Route 39 → Olivine → Routes 40-41 → Cianwood City
steps.text: Head west on Routes 38-39 (Moomoo Farm) to the port of Olivine City. The Gym is empty: Jasmine is at the top of the Lighthouse looking after the sick Ampharos that lights it, and asks you to fetch medicine from Cianwood. Surf west across Routes 40-41 to Cianwood City and beat Chuck while you're there.
todo: Climb the Olivine Lighthouse and meet Jasmine
Beat Chuck for the Storm Badge (and TM01 Focus Punch)
catch: Electric/Steel, great vs Chuck's Poliwrath and Pryce's Seel
{Water/Flying, HeartGold only|Water, learns Ice moves later}

boss.name: Gym Leader Chuck
boss.tip: Both of his Pokémon know Focus Punch (it fails if you hit them first that turn). Primeape has Rock Slide for your birds, Poliwrath has Hypnosis and Surf. Kadabra or Haunter are ideal; Electric or Grass for Poliwrath. Level 30 recommended.

steps.title: Get the medicine (and Fly)
steps.text: The Cianwood Pharmacy gives you the SecretPotion. Chuck's wife, waiting outside in town, gives you HM02 Fly once you have his badge, and a man in a house nearby lends you a Shuckle. Suicune and Eusine show up on the coast here too.
todo: Get HM02 Fly from Chuck's wife
Get the SecretPotion at the Cianwood Pharmacy

steps.title: Gym 5: Jasmine
steps.text: Fly back to Olivine, climb the Lighthouse and give Amphy the SecretPotion. Jasmine then returns to her Gym (no other trainers inside).
todo: Give the SecretPotion to Amphy at the top of the Lighthouse
Beat Jasmine for the Mineral Badge (and TM23 Iron Tail)

boss.name: Gym Leader Jasmine
boss.tip: Magnemite use Thunderbolt and Thunder Wave, and fall to Ground or Fire. Steelix (35) sets up Sandstorm and hits with Iron Tail: Fire, Water (Surf), Fighting or Ground moves. Machoke and Quilava/Typhlosion shine here.

steps.title: Lake of Rage and the red Gyarados
steps.where: Route 42 → Mahogany Town → Route 43 → Lake of Rage
steps.text: Fly to Ecruteak and go east on Route 42 (through Mt. Mortar) to Mahogany Town. The Gym guy says Pryce is busy, and something weird is happening up north: go up Route 43 (Rocket grunts charge a toll in the gate) to the Lake of Rage, where a red Gyarados is rampaging. Battle it (level 30) and you get the Red Scale. Lance is waiting on the shore.
todo: Battle the red Gyarados at the Lake of Rage (catch it!)
Get HM04 Strength from the man on Route 42 (you need it in the Ice Path later)
catch: Water/Flying, a top attacker. Weak only to Electric (4x) and Rock
Electric, if you don't have one yet
Fighting for Pryce and Karen later
steps.watch: Mt. Mortar is optional now, but the Karate King deep inside gives you a Tyrogue.

steps.title: Raid the Team Rocket hideout
steps.text: Lance meets you at the Mahogany souvenir shop: the hideout is underneath. Avoid the Persian statues (they set off alarms), find the passwords from the grunts, and team up with Lance against Ariana. On the bottom floor, beat Petrel and knock out the three Electrode powering the radio signal. Lance gives you HM05 Whirlpool.

boss.name: Executive Petrel
boss.tip: Zubat, Raticate and Koffing in the low 20s: an easy fight.

boss.name: Executive Ariana (double battle with Lance)
boss.tip: Lance's Dragonite does most of the work.

steps.watch: Bring Repels and Full Heals; the hideout is long and full of poison users.

steps.title: Gym 6: Pryce
steps.text: Slide across the ice floor to reach Pryce. Seel and Dewgong stall with Rest; Piloswine is part Ground (Electric moves won't touch it) and has Blizzard.
todo: Beat Pryce for the Glacier Badge (and TM07 Hail)

boss.name: Gym Leader Pryce
boss.tip: Fire and Fighting moves hit all three. Electric or Grass for Seel and Dewgong; Water or Grass for Piloswine. Level 32-35 recommended.

steps.title: Free the Radio Tower
steps.text: Team Rocket has taken over the Goldenrod Radio Tower. Fight up to the 5F, where the "Director" is Petrel in disguise: he hands you the Basement Key. The real Director is locked in the warehouse at the end of the Goldenrod Tunnel (enter from the north or south underground entrance, then the basement door). Your rival is down there too. The Director gives you the Card Key; go back up the tower, beat Ariana, and finally Archer on the Observation Deck. The Director rewards you with the {Rainbow Wing|Silver Wing}.
todo: Get the Basement Key from Petrel on Radio Tower 5F
Beat the rival in the Goldenrod Tunnel
Rescue the Director in the underground warehouse (Card Key)
Beat Archer on the Observation Deck

boss.name: Rival
boss.weak: Golbat: Electric, Psychic, Ice, Rock; Sneasel: Fighting (4x)
boss.tip: Five Pokémon in the low 30s. A Fighting move erases Sneasel.

boss.name: Executive Proton (4F)
boss.tip: Golbat confuses you, Weezing lowers your accuracy with SmokeScreen.

boss.name: Executive Petrel (5F)
boss.tip: Five Koffing and a Weezing: watch for explosions.

boss.name: Executive Ariana
boss.tip: Vileplume can put you to sleep.

boss.name: Executive Archer
boss.tip: Houndoom is the threat: Water or Ground moves.

steps.title: Ice Path to Blackthorn and Clair
steps.text: Go east from Mahogany on Route 44 into the Ice Path. You'll need Strength for the boulders, and you pick up HM07 Waterfall inside. Slide across the ice puzzles to reach Blackthorn City, then cross the Gym's lava floor to Clair.
todo: Beat Clair in the Blackthorn Gym
catch: Ice/Psychic: Ice moves are what you need vs Clair and Lance
Ice/Ground; Piloswine is a good Ice attacker
Water/Ice: one of the best answers to the Dragon users

boss.name: Gym Leader Clair
boss.weak: Ice, Dragon (Gyarados: Electric 4x, Rock; Kingdra only Dragon)
boss.tip: Every one knows Dragon Pulse. The Dragonair use Thunder Wave (bring Paralyze Heals) and one has Fire Blast. Kingdra (41) uses Hydro Pump and Hyper Beam and only Dragon moves hit it super-effectively: use your strongest attacker. Ice moves crush the Dragonair. Aim for level 38-40.

steps.title: Pass Clair's test in the Dragon's Den
steps.text: Clair won't hand over the badge until you pass the Dragon Master's test. Surf through the Dragon's Den to the shrine in the middle and answer the elder's questions about how you treat Pokémon (be kind). Then Clair gives you the Rising Badge.
todo: Pass the Dragon Master's quiz in the shrine
steps.watch: Answer every question the kind way and the elder gives you a Dratini that knows ExtremeSpeed.

steps.title: Elm's Master Ball
steps.text: With all eight Johto badges, Fly back to New Bark Town. Elm gives you the Master Ball and says the Kimono Girls are looking for you.
todo: Get the Master Ball from Prof. Elm

steps.title: The Kimono Girls and {Ho-Oh|Lugia}
steps.text: In Ecruteak your rival confronts you, then the Kimono Girls at the Dance Theater give you the {Clear Bell. Take it and the Rainbow Wing to the top of the Bell Tower, where they dance to call Ho-Oh (level 45)|Tidal Bell. Take it and the Silver Wing to the bottom of the Whirl Islands, where they dance to call Lugia (level 45)}. Save before the battle; the Master Ball is an option.
todo: Get the {Clear Bell|Tidal Bell} from the Kimono Girls
Meet {Ho-Oh at the Bell Tower summit|Lugia in the Whirl Islands}
catch: level 45, one chance: save first. Use False Swipe and a sleep move, or the Master Ball

boss.name: Kimono Girls
boss.tip: Before handing over the bell, the five Kimono Girls test you one after another, each with one level 38 Eeveelution (Espeon, Jolteon, Umbreon, Vaporeon, Flareon). Bring a mixed team and heal between battles.

steps.title: The Pokémon League
steps.where: Route 27 → Tohjo Falls → Route 26 → Victory Road → Indigo Plateau
steps.text: Surf east from New Bark Town onto Route 27, climb Tohjo Falls with Waterfall and walk up Route 26 to the League Reception Gate, which checks your badges. Your rival waits near the end of Victory Road. At Indigo Plateau, stock up (Full Restores, Revives) and face the Elite Four back to back with no healing in between, then Champion Lance.
todo: Beat the rival in Victory Road

boss.name: Rival (Victory Road)
boss.tip: Six Pokémon up to level 40.

boss.name: Elite Four Will
boss.tip: Xatu are Psychic/Flying: Electric, Ice, Rock, Ghost, Dark.

boss.name: Elite Four Koga
boss.tip: Crobat is fast; Forretress is Bug/Steel (Fire 4x).

boss.name: Elite Four Bruno
boss.tip: Onix is Rock/Ground: Water or Grass.

boss.name: Elite Four Karen
boss.tip: Vileplume and Gengar break the theme: Psychic, Fire, Flying for those.

boss.name: Champion Lance
boss.tip: Three Dragonite (Ice 4x), Gyarados (Electric 4x), Aerodactyl and Charizard (Rock, Water). Bring an Ice user and an Electric user, level 45-50.

steps.title: Sail to Kanto
steps.text: After the credits, wake up at home and visit Elm: he gives you the S.S. Ticket. Fly to Olivine and take the S.S. Aqua to Vermilion City in Kanto.
todo: Get the S.S. Ticket from Elm
Ride the S.S. Aqua to Vermilion

steps.title: Kanto gym: Lt. Surge
steps.text: Kanto's eight gyms can be done in any order; this is a smooth route. Lt. Surge is right where the boat docks. Solve the hidden-switch trash can puzzle to reach him.
todo: Beat Lt. Surge for the Thunder Badge

boss.name: Gym Leader Lt. Surge
boss.tip: A Ground type stops the whole team; Electrode are fast and can explode.

steps.title: Kanto gym: Sabrina
steps.text: Walk north from Vermilion to Saffron City. The Gym is a teleport-pad maze.
todo: Beat Sabrina for the Marsh Badge

boss.name: Gym Leader Sabrina
boss.tip: Tyranitar, Umbreon, Houndoom or Gengar. Alakazam is very fast but fragile.

steps.title: Kanto gym: Erika
steps.text: West of Saffron is Celadon City. Cut the small tree to get into Erika's flower Gym.
todo: Beat Erika for the Rainbow Badge

boss.name: Gym Leader Erika
boss.tip: Any Fire or Flying attacker; Jumpluff is fast and can Sleep Powder.

steps.title: Fix the Power Plant
steps.where: Route 10 Power Plant → Cerulean City → Lavender Town
steps.text: The Power Plant (Route 10, north of Lavender) has lost a machine part, so the Magnet Train is down. The thief hid it in the Cerulean Gym; a Team Rocket straggler on Route 24 or 25 knows more. Return the part to the manager, then visit the Lavender Radio Tower for the EXPN Card: tune it to the Poké Flute station to wake the Snorlax blocking Diglett's Cave (Route 11) and the Route 12 Snorlax.
todo: Hear the manager's story at the Power Plant
Get the EXPN Card at the Lavender Radio Tower
catch: Route 11 / Route 12, level 50 (wake it with the Poké Flute channel)

steps.title: Kanto gym: Misty
steps.where: Cerulean City (Misty is on a date at Cerulean Cape, Route 25)
steps.text: If the Cerulean Gym is empty, Misty is out at the cape at the end of Route 25. Go interrupt her date and she'll head back to her Gym.
todo: Beat Misty for the Cascade Badge

boss.name: Gym Leader Misty
boss.tip: Quagsire is Water/Ground (Grass 4x, Electric does nothing). Lapras is Water/Ice.

steps.title: Kanto gym: Janine
steps.where: Routes 12-15 or Cycling Road → Fuchsia City
steps.text: Fuchsia City is south. In Janine's Gym the trainers are disguised as her: talk to each to find the real one.
todo: Beat Janine for the Soul Badge

boss.name: Gym Leader Janine
boss.tip: A Psychic type sweeps; Crobat is Poison/Flying so Ground won't hit it.

steps.title: Kanto gym: Brock
steps.text: With the Route 11 Snorlax gone, Diglett's Cave takes you from Vermilion to the west side of Kanto. Pewter City is north of Route 2.
todo: Beat Brock for the Boulder Badge

boss.name: Gym Leader Brock
boss.tip: Water or Grass moves do 4x to Graveler, Rhyhorn, Onix (Grass) and Omastar/Kabutops (Grass).

steps.title: Kanto gym: Blaine
steps.where: Pallet Town → Route 21 → Cinnabar → Seafoam Islands
steps.text: The volcano wiped out Cinnabar's Gym, so Blaine runs it from a cave in the Seafoam Islands (Route 20). Surf south from Pallet Town or west from Fuchsia.
todo: Beat Blaine for the Volcano Badge

boss.name: Gym Leader Blaine
boss.tip: Surf handles all three; Magcargo is Fire/Rock (Water 4x).

steps.title: Kanto gym: Blue
steps.text: Blue's Gym in Viridian opens once you have the other seven Kanto badges.
todo: Beat Blue for the Earth Badge

boss.name: Gym Leader Blue
boss.tip: Pidgeot (Electric/Ice/Rock), Arcanine and Rhydon (Water), Gyarados (Electric), Exeggutor (Fire/Bug/Ice), Machamp (Psychic/Flying). Level 55+.

steps.title: Mt. Silver: the final battle
steps.where: Pallet Town → Route 22 → Route 28 → Mt. Silver
steps.text: With all 16 badges, talk to Prof. Oak in his Pallet Town lab: he opens Mt. Silver for you. Go west from Viridian on Route 22, through the gate to Route 28 and climb Mt. Silver to the summit. The trainer waiting at the top is the strongest in the game.
todo: Get Prof. Oak's permission for Mt. Silver
Beat the trainer at the summit

boss.name: Pkmn Trainer Red
boss.tip: Levels 80-88, and it hails at the summit, chipping your team every turn. Train to 75+ and bring Full Restores and Revives. Pikachu is fast; Snorlax is the bulkiest.

steps.title: You've beaten the story!
steps.text: Ideas for the post-game: rematch gym leaders by phone, chase Raikou, Entei and Suicune, catch the other legendary at {Whirl Islands (Lugia)|Bell Tower (Ho-Oh)}, take on the Battle Frontier near Cianwood, and complete the Pokédex.
